# BAD-056 — Reword web/start.js's head comment after the web/app.js split

## Brief
After BAD-044, web/start.js lines 1-2 still say 'app.js wires handlers that booth.js defines, so booting from either file would depend on which one happened to load last' — true in effect but stale in wording now that app.js is the last of twelve app files wiring handlers from every view script. The spike (section 5) notes it; it was outside BAD-044's deliverables.

Evidence: web/start.js:1-2 on feat/bad-044-split-web-app; spike docs/spikes/bad-036/web-app.md section 5 ('Its comment ("once both files are evaluated") goes stale in wording only'). app.js's own closing comment was reworded in BAD-044 to 'handlers that the other view scripts define'.
